symptom: ako/mxcli#842: `gallery g (DataSource: …, onClick: call nanoflow M.Open(Item = $currentObject))` passed `check`, `exec` printed "Created page", and nothing was stored — describe showed no action (and `Selection: Single`), and re-executing the page with only the onClick changed reported "Unchanged". Same for `nanoflow …` and `OnClick:` spellings; `onSelectionChange:` / `onConfigurationChange:` warned MDL-WIDGET06 "not yet persisted". The data grid beside it kept its onClick.
cause: The Gallery's definition is HAND-WRITTEN and embedded (sdk/widgets/definitions/gallery.def.json, mirrored in modelsdk/), so it never got the action mappings the generator learnt for generated defs like the data grid's (ledger #67). With no mapping resolveMapping never read the AST's Action slot. The validator let it through because `Action`/`OnChange` are in isBuiltinPropName, accepted on every widget without asking whether this definition routes them. Describe's gallery branch also read no action, so the drop was invisible.
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/gallery.def.json + modelsdk copy (onClick/OnClick, onSelectionChange, onConfigurationChange action mappings); mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go (MDL-WIDGET37 for an action keyword no mapping reads, defRoutesActionSource); mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (refuseUnroutedActionKeywords, same refusal for exec --no-check); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + _output.go + _pluggable.go (gallery OnClick, NamedActions, Selection None, onClickTrigger); mdl/executor/validate_widget_gallery_click.go (MDL-WIDGET36); mdl/executor/validate_widget_language.go (GateWidgetViolations, MDL-V1-ACTIONSLOT / MDL-V1-GALLERYCLICK)
insight: A hand-written built-in def beats the generator, so audit ALL of them when one lacks what the generator emits: diff each template's Action-typed PropertyKeys against the def's action mappings — Gallery (3 slots), the four data-grid filters (onChange), barcodescanner (onDetect), combobox (4 named slots) were all unmapped. Only Gallery is fixed to write (under both versions — a silent wrong write). `onClick:`/`OnChange:` on a def with no mapping sourced from them is a NEW rejection, so per ADR-0011 it is refused only under `mdl 1;` (check MDL-WIDGET37 + engine for exec --no-check) and warns MDL-V1-ACTIONSLOT while still dropping under mdl 0; it cannot be a false refusal because resolveMapping reads those keywords ONLY through such a mapping. Validators emit the Change code and GateWidgetViolations maps it by prog.LanguageVersion — every caller (ValidateWidgetProperties, the LSP) must go through it. Second trap: once the onClick is actually written, Gallery 3.4.0's editorConfig check fires in `mx check` — "The item click action is ambiguous" when itemSelection != None AND onClick AND onClickTrigger == single — and mxcli's defaults (Selection Single, trigger single) hit it every time; measured on an ako/TestApp copy (mx 11.14). `check` refuses that as MDL-WIDGET36 under mdl 1 and warns MDL-V1-GALLERYCLICK under mdl 0 while still writing it (the MDL-V1-REMOTETYPE precedent) — use `Selection: None` or `onClickTrigger: double`, and describe now emits `Selection: None` (extractGallerySelection read None as unset while exec's default is Single) and a non-default `onClickTrigger`, so describe -> exec of a legal gallery stays legal and 'Unchanged'. mx check was the oracle only for the ambiguity rule; for the drop itself verify by describe + bson dump of the gallery's onClick property.
